decision: Consume the exact committed Stage 4 state.
rationale: Stage 5 must not recreate or reinterpret upstream analytical inputs.
analytical_implication: All Stage 5 values trace to committed Stage 4 outputs.

decision: Use only Stage 4-authorized numeric comparison uses in cross-source/period figures.
rationale: No directly comparable cross-source use exists.
analytical_implication: No new numeric comparison is introduced.

decision: Preserve SRC010 recalled versus current-period distinctions.
rationale: Retrospective recall is not an independent historical panel or survey wave.
analytical_implication: Figure and finding language avoid panel/trend claims beyond source-defined responses.

decision: Label fuel + food/drink values as a source-defined mixed bundle.
rationale: Food/personal expenditure is outside the project operating-cost boundary.
analytical_implication: No project operating-cost or project-net subtraction is implied.

decision: Label 20% deduction values as driver-reported prevalence.
rationale: Reported categories are not transaction-level realized deductions.
analytical_implication: No realized deduction or commission claim is made.

decision: Keep the two SRC029 unit-economics metrics textual/tabular rather than plotting them on a common comparison scale.
rationale: Per-hour and per-order rates have different denominators and a joint magnitude chart would encourage invalid comparison.
analytical_implication: Rates remain ratio-of-source-means summaries with denominator-specific interpretation.

decision: Bound findings to source/sample evidence and explicit caveats.
rationale: Convenience/purposive and geographically different samples do not justify national generalization.
analytical_implication: No overall welfare/sustainability conclusion is forced.

decision: Carry the incomplete gross-to-net chain forward as an evidence boundary.
rationale: Missing bridge components cannot be silently reconstructed.
analytical_implication: Project net operating earnings remain unavailable.
